definition: The group of words that name the workbench's pages. Each one heads its own page and says what the page shows and how to read it.
basis: schema/glossary-term.schema.json, the description of `family`, which lists the families in the order the Glossary page shows them: "`surface` holds the pages of the workbench, each record heading its own page", and "Each value is bound by exactly one `family-<value>` record, whose term heads the group on the page."
